title: Jamaican Fried Dumplings Flatbread
description: A twist on traditional flatbread, filled with spiced dumplings and fried to perfection.
instructions: Heat 2 inches of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Cut the Jamaican fried dumplings into small pieces.
In a bowl, mix together the monsoon seasoning blend and a pinch of salt.
Dredge the flatbread triangles in the seasoned mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Fry the flatbread triangles in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the fried flatbread on paper towels.
Fry the Jamaican fried dumplings in batches until crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the fried dumplings on paper towels.
Serve the fried dumplings on top of the fried flatbread triangles.
